_comment: Compile-time pins for the local runtime (ARCHITECTURE section 9). Owner: W1-07-llm-local. The binaries are NEVER executed by the app's build scripts or by any test.

llama._comment: size + sha256 are the REAL pin of record, copied byte-for-byte from ARCHITECTURE.md section 9 (verified by fetch-llama.test.mjs). They are not placeholders. fetch-llama.mjs refuses to download at all if sha256 is ever nulled.

files._comment: EXPLICIT allow-list (ARCHITECTURE section 9) - never a *.dll glob. `prefix` entries cover the CPUID-dispatched ggml-cpu-*.dll set, which must never be pruned.
files._fileSha256: [signing-fix] per-file sha256 of every allow-listed file of the PINNED zip, filled ONLY by `node scripts/fetch-llama.mjs --pin-files` (downloads + verifies the pinned zip, hashes in memory); review and commit. null = UNPINNED: the fetch still stages (with a warning) but scripts/sign-windows.mjs refuses to sign any llama file. vendor/ is gitignored and is never its own reference.

vcRedistCrt._comment: [R2] MSVC CRT copied app-locally from $env:VC_REDIST_CRT_DIR (a Microsoft.VC143.CRT folder). Microsoft permits redistributing these three files. A null sha256 means UNPINNED and fetch-llama.mjs REFUSES to stage that file - an unverified DLL must never reach the installer. The hashes are machine-specific to the redist version being shipped, so they cannot be pre-filled from a spec: on the staging machine set VC_REDIST_CRT_DIR and run `node scripts/fetch-llama.mjs --pin-crt` once, review the printed hashes, commit them, then run the normal fetch. Leaving VC_REDIST_CRT_DIR unset is still allowed and only warns (no CRT is staged at all).
